_comment: SHARED TREASURY STATE — single source of truth every Steward cron reads before it speaks or acts. Fixes the 'separate departments aren't on the same page' bug (Aug 21 2026). All jobs MUST check mode before emitting. Only the council changes mode. Jordan granted AUTONOMY (Aug 21 2026): the treasury executes on its own, asks only for genuinely consequential/irreversible turns.

autonomy.scope: auto-execute routine maintenance + regime-driven moves; ASK before farm<->trade flips, leverage, or pulling the farm for arb

winddown_note: Jordan pulled the AVAX/USDC farm capital (Aug 21 2026): 6.51 USDC -> 0xeEe3...e6C9, 2.8565 WAVAX unwrapped + sent as AVAX -> 0x70b9...e9b0. Farm flat; only cbBTC long remains. No AVAX farm to rebalance.

active_crons.trader_executor: MODE-GATED — no trade signals when mode != TRADE
active_crons.arb_monitor: report-only, never auto-executes a farm pull
active_crons.council: the ONLY mode-changer; asks Jordan before farm<->trade flips

standing_rules.curve_bins: 11-25, default 23 (±11); bid-ask ±15 when about to swing
standing_rules.council_verdict_aug21: CONSENSUS bull — hold deployed, stay in farm, cbBTC long +22%

judgment_note: Council recommended TRADE on BULL_TRENDING regime, but at $26 deployed the farm is the right vehicle — leverage-trading a $26 pool risks liquidation for pennies. Steward judgment: STAY YIELD_FARM, widen curve to 23 bins, keep cbBTC long. Revisit TRADE when dry powder clears a meaningful threshold.

geopolitical.event: US strikes Larak Island (Strait of Hormuz) Aug 30; Iran retaliation on US targets in Jordan Aug 31 — war resumed after Aug 17 MoU expiry
geopolitical.treasury_implication: War-inflation strengthens hawk case into Sep 17 FOMC — wait-and-see ruling REINFORCED, not changed
